about_the_game:
A collection of music centered around the human voice, perfect for bringing your fantasy world to life.
From solo vocals to opera, choirs, and ethereal folk-style chants, this set highlights a wide variety of vocal performances to create a rich and immersive atmosphere.

This pack mainly features slow-paced tracks ideal for exploration scenes, labyrinths, and dungeons. However, you're not limited to those settings—these tracks can also enhance action sequences, story events, or any other scene your imagination leads you to.

If you’ve ever wanted to incorporate subtle or haunting vocals into your background music, this collection is highly recommended.

Composer & Arranger: Takayuki Amanuma (X: @amanumatakayuki)
Illustration: Teruyuki Endo (X: @bluecielo_est)

■ Included Tracks

  • Sky Garden (Dungeon)

  • Crystal Palace (Dungeon)

  • Slumber of the Gods (Dungeon)

  • Phantom of Time (Dungeon)

  • A World Shrouded in Mist (Dungeon)

  • Lost Sanctuary (Dungeon)

  • Like a Flower in Full Bloom (Dungeon)

  • Forest of Oblivion (Dungeon)

  • Call of the Darkness (Dungeon)

  • Lost Children of Time (Dungeon)

  • The Wind Carries an Ancient Song (Dungeon)

  • Beyond the Broken Path (Dungeon)

  • Endless Labyrinth (Dungeon)

  • Corridor of Silence (Dungeon)

-----------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
